body:
As a Sci-Fi lover, Hello World was an unexpectedly great experience for me. As it goes for most recent anime films, the visuals are fantastic and spice up the experience the film delivers. Although, as few as they are, the characters are not deep and certainly needed more development. The way the plot is explained is also not very clear and may leave the audience baffled. These two points are probably why it is rated as it is, since probably most people didn't really understand what was going on.

But Sci-Fi-wise, the story is quite brilliant. At first it starts like a run-of-the-mill high school romance drama, but soon enough it changes with the appearance of the future Katagaki. And as the film gets into the second half, with some quick hints here and there we realize the story is more complex than what we thought it was. Saying anything further, borders on spoiling the story, so if you like Sci-Fi stories, give this one a try and enjoy.

You must watch the 3 episodes before the movie to understand what's happened and why . The first half was good but the problem is that they tried to show alot of things related to quantum physics, and the last quarter was too complicated and not very stable. Nice movie but not great one.

One of the best sci fi anime made with the heart plot and twists. The last scene will change everything you thought you know. I would definitely recommend to watch it. Perhaps two three times is must to understand it fully and completely. Recommended 100%

I never expected anything when i first watched it but it turned out to be one of the best anime films i've watched so far! I think this is the type of movies that you need to rewatch again and again especially this is kinda confusing because of its "inception-like" thing. I like how the story was able to incorporate quantum physics and computer science futuristic stuffs here. The soundtracks are the BOMB. When i first watched it i also noticed something odd in the animation but it has an explanation related to the movie. I also wish that it will receive the same love how the world loved your name/kimi no nawa last 2016 because it is such an excellent masterpiece.
First half was really nice, but second half could have been better. Anyways, I loved it. Quite underappreciated to be honest.
